svg.title: Table layouts and their shards
svg.desc: The unit table of a balanced panel becomes the panel engine's Shard. The unit table of an unbalanced panel and the row table of repeated cross-sections become the row engine's RowShard.
svg.text: m whole units, for the panel engine
in an unbalanced panel and is None
m rows of u whole units, for the row engine
one row per unit with all T periods
lists run over the unit's observed periods
